description: The pace bands of one track (docs/SPEC.md FR-4.8), slowest 0 to fastest 4, 2 being the track's typical pace, as runs of point indices; a run starts at the point before the one whose speed it takes, so neighbouring runs share their boundary point. m is the distance-weighted median speed, z = ln(speed / m), and one band is w = max(0.10, 2 * the distance-weighted median of |z|) wide: band = floor(z / w + 2.5), kept to 0..4, 0 for no speed. Only points with a speed and a distance weigh in; with none, every point is 2. Input: speeds and distances, one each per point, a point's being from the point before it. Run by the server (internal/httpapi) and by Android for the Sync tab's candidates, which aren't on the server.

cases.name: a steady track stays at its typical pace
one glitch stands out without flattening the rest
a step is at least 10%, so a small change is the next band
a track that varies a lot gets wider steps
the typical pace is by distance, not by point
a stop is slowest and weighs nothing
a stretch with no distance can't move the typical pace
the first point's speed sets nothing
a flat track is all the middle band
a track with no distance is all the middle band
fewer than two points have no runs
